For, **MOUSE → LNTRD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e34951891df609a94d6d83c34a1bff71786e7c4743b3fcab816f2d96603adf37.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/785cc2de1b4f1ce4094dac8d7d4571ddebefe3d9e30e1bc36c96304bf4dcb7ab.png]
